metaTitle: Custom Neon Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom neon luggage ID tags for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints. Bright, durable tags to make your bags stand out.
introHtml: Neon luggage ID tags are designed for visibility. Whether you're branding gear for a safety team or creating promotional giveaways for a music festival, the bright colors make bags easy to spot on carousels and crowded racks. These tags are printed with your logo using pad printing or screen printing for crisp, long-lasting color. Choose from multiple neon shades to match your brand palette.
heroAltText: Bright custom neon luggage ID tags with logo, perfect for bulk promotional orders and easy bag identification.
